title: SmtpTemplatesPostRequestBodyContentApplicationJsonSchemaSender
description: Sender details including id or email and name (_optional_). Only one of either Sender's email or Sender's ID shall be passed in one request at a time. For example: **{"name":"xyz", "email":"example@abc.com"}** **{"name":"xyz", "id":123}**

id.description: Select the sender for the template on the basis of sender id. _In order to select a sender with specific pool of IP’s, dedicated ip users shall pass id (instead of email)_.

name.description: Name of the sender. **If not passed, will be set to default**
